answer: The easiest path is to leave your 9–5 structure alone and just repurpose that Friday learning hour into a portfolio hour for four weeks: week 1, pick your three strongest recent client projects and dump the case-study notes while they're fresh; weeks 2 and 3, build out one case study each; week 4, polish, write the intro, and publish. Give each portfolio piece its own card in your "This Week" dashboard right alongside the client cards, with a real deadline and a single next action — that way it competes fairly for the 4–5pm flex block instead of quietly getting bumped every time a client pings you. And if a week gets eaten by deadlines, your neighborhood seasons photography project is a ready-made personal piece you can slot in without starting from zero.
